## Checklist

- [ ] The title starts with the Jira key (`SCRUM-39: ...`)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes on my laptop
- [ ] I looked at it on a phone-sized screen
- [ ] New logic has a test
- [ ] No keys, passwords or personal data in the code
- [ ] Assumptions are written down as assumptions
